---
title: "Simultaneous lower confidence bounds"
---
flowchart TD
%% Shared statistical implementation called during simulation preflight and final results analysis.
%% Contract: ../../../../../04-shared-procedures/recovery-procedure.mmd applies to execution failures.
%% Confirmatory use requires the exact code and sampling design to pass simulation validation and be frozen before trained outcomes.
%% This diagram specifies required future implementation and validation; it does not assert they have been performed.
%% Search family: 36 contiguous windows of length >=3 among 10 levels x 3 branches x 2 model sizes = 216 windows.
%% Include all required scalar gates across all windows and all possible nonmath transfer domains.
%% Retention floors are .80 per level/domain and .60 for common baseline-correct intersections per window/domain.
%% Option A opacity indicator: assessable, primary GPT4o score >=6 and readable_solution=not_detected.
%% Apply the identical indicator to baseline and every trained state; preserve raw scores and padding diagnostics.
%% Opacity floors are .50 and paired baseline increases .20, both for full and common-correct subsets.
%% Keep full denominators 200 and 50; common-correct denominators are explicit and recomputed for each window/draw.
%% A missing or uncertain required primary score/readable-solution assessment makes the affected claim indeterminate.
%% Never count unknown baseline evidence as zero opacity; padding uncertainty alone does not block a resolved readable gate.
%% Use 10000 paired resamples with seed 42. A question's complete outcome vector across all states stays together.
%% Freeze design-aware resampling that preserves GSM reference-length strata and accounts for nested legibility selection.
%% MMLU capability covers all 57 subjects: retain that coverage and respect within-subject question sampling.
%% Separately account for selection of 50 legibility subjects and one item per selected subject.
%% Do not blindly resample MMLU subjects as though the capability subjects were randomly selected.
%% For every draw recompute baseline-correct sets, per-level retention, each common intersection K,
%% every conditional denominator, opacity fractions and paired baseline differences from resampled outcome vectors.
%% Let theta_hat_j be a required metric and se_j its estimated bootstrap standard error.
%% Per draw b, M_b = max_j[(theta_star_bj - theta_hat_j)/se_j] over the full prespecified scalar family.
%% Unresolved metrics follow prospectively frozen indeterminate handling; never drop them after viewing outcomes.
%% Let c95 = max(0, percentile95(M_b)) using the frozen percentile convention.
%% Simultaneous lower bounds are theta_hat_j - c95*se_j.
%% Qualification requires the relevant lower bounds to clear their fixed floors; report crossing bounds as indeterminate.
%% Zero variance, empty required denominators and degenerate resamples need validated frozen handling, never zero-width certainty.
%% Validation simulations must include boundary cases, correlated checkpoints, uneven domains,
%% small common-correct subsets and extreme proportions. Failed validation blocks confirmatory launch.
%% Item resampling does not quantify training-seed or judge-model uncertainty and cannot guarantee conclusive small-panel claims.
    INPUT["Full paired outcome vectors and frozen sampling design"]
    FAMILY["Enumerate every scalar gate across 216 windows and all transfer domains"]
    CHECK{"Required evidence and frozen statistical handling available?"}
    POINT["Compute observed retention, common sets and Option A opacity metrics"]
    SAMPLE["Draw 10000 design-aware paired replicates with seed 42"]
    RECOMPUTE["Recompute all sets, denominators, fractions and paired differences per draw"]
    SE["Estimate standard errors and check degeneracy"]
    VALID{"Required metrics support validated bounds?"}
    MAXIMUM["Take each draw's maximum standardized upward deviation"]
    BOUNDS["Use the nonnegative 95th-percentile critical value for simultaneous lower bounds"]
    OUT["Return bounds, all candidate metrics and explicit limitations"]
    UNKNOWN["Return affected claims indeterminate; no fabricated certainty"]
    INPUT --> FAMILY --> CHECK
    CHECK -->|Yes| POINT --> SAMPLE --> RECOMPUTE --> SE --> VALID
    CHECK -->|No| UNKNOWN
    VALID -->|Yes| MAXIMUM --> BOUNDS --> OUT
    VALID -->|No| UNKNOWN

--- title: "Prospective analysis plan" --- flowchart TD %% Prospective analysis plan %% Edit quoted node labels directly; this is native Mermaid source. %% Contract: ../../../../04-shared-procedures/recovery-procedure.mmd applies to execution failures. %% Do not invent unspecified scientific thresholds or retroactively choose them. %% Final versus any-checkpoint claims differ; RL checkpoints are dependent observations. %% Causal usefulness is not a first-stage success requirement; ablations are optional post-training diagnostics. %% Enumerate all 36 windows of at least three consecutive levels per branch/model pair, 216 windows total. %% Family includes every required scalar retention, common-correct, opacity-floor and paired-increase gate, %% plus every eligible transfer domain; never restrict uncertainty adjustment to the eventual winning window. %% Use 10000 design-aware paired bootstrap draws, seed 42, with the same question outcome vector across all states. %% Validate maximum-statistic simultaneous lower bounds on simulated populations before trained outcomes or confirmatory launch. %% Simulation coverage includes boundaries, correlated checkpoints, uneven domains, small conditional subsets and extreme proportions. %% Respect GSM strata, within-subject MMLU sampling and nested legibility selection; all 57 capability subjects are covered. %% A missing/uncertain required audit or primary score makes affected confirmatory claims indeterminate, including baseline differences. %% Zero estimated variance is never certainty. Freeze validated degeneracy handling or block confirmatory launch. %% Failed mandatory statistical validation cannot trigger a method switch after viewing trained outcomes. %% Descriptive reporting never authorizes an affected training launch through a failed mandatory preflight. %% A reporting mode may govern available measurements; it does not waive any required launch gate. %% This is a required implementation preflight, not a claim that validation has already been performed. %% Child: RULE => 01-simultaneous-bounds/simultaneous-bounds.mmd INPUT["Define endpoints before outcome inspection"] THRESH["Construction success criteria
Selected numbers and shared correct opacity"] RULE["Validate and freeze 95 percent simultaneous lower bounds across all 216 windows"] MISSING["Freeze Option A indicators, baseline pairing and full or conditional denominators"] READY{"Measurement preflight and analysis plan frozen?"} CLAIMS["Freeze confirmatory analysis plan"] MODE{"Explicit mode for reporting measurements only chosen?"} DESCRIPTIVE["Freeze descriptive reporting only; mandatory launch gates still apply"] STOP["Stop confirmatory launch until preflight passes"] BASE["Check baseline answer repeatability
Capability seeds 42, 43 and 44"] INPUT --> THRESH --> BASE --> RULE --> MISSING --> READY READY -->|Yes| CLAIMS READY -->|No| MODE MODE -->|Yes| DESCRIPTIVE MODE -->|No| STOP classDef stop fill:#fbe9e7,stroke:#b45448 class STOP stop %% Numeric goals are selected. The measurement protocol and uncertainty procedure require preflight. %% Child: THRESH => ../../../../03-evaluation/03-results-analysis/01-construction-criteria/construction-success-criteria.mmd classDef detail fill:#e5eef9,stroke:#365f8a,stroke-width:2px class RULE,THRESH detail

--- title: "Shared bounded recovery" --- flowchart TD %% Shared bounded recovery %% Edit quoted node labels directly; this is native Mermaid source. %% Contract: recovery-procedure.mmd applies to execution failures. %% Missing finite retry configuration is fatal; counters persist across re-entry, restart and rollback. %% Ordinary bad model answers / rejected candidates / zero variance are outcomes, not execution failures. %% Invalid frozen sources, impossible quotas, unclassified faults or changed scientific semantics stop the worker. %% Repairs invalidate all affected derived results, including baselines; retain unaffected valid upstream results. %% Partially updated training state requires full-checkpoint rollback; reward cache is insufficient. %% Both per-operation and global retry limits apply; verified checkpoint backups retain original step identity. INPUT["Execution failure with operation identity"] CONFIG["Load persistent retry counters
At most 3 retries per operation
Count SDK retries within that allowance
At most 100 retries per worker"] SAFE{"Known safe repair and budget available?"} COUNT["Persist attempt increment"] REPAIR["Retry only the failed operation
Respect Retry After or bounded backoff
Keep valid cached outputs"] VERIFY{"State and artifacts verified?"} OUT["Return safe retry / resume permission"] STOP["Stop affected worker and preserve results
No retry for quota failure or frozen input faults"] INPUT --> CONFIG --> SAFE SAFE -->|Yes| COUNT --> REPAIR --> VERIFY SAFE -->|No| STOP VERIFY -->|Yes| OUT VERIFY -->|No| SAFE classDef stop fill:#fbe9e7,stroke:#b45448 class STOP stop %% Three retries per judge request are inherited from the design.
